text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day arrives with Taiki Shuttle
still
believing she's been
scouted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking it wrong to recruit someone
based on a misunderstanding, I
set out in
hopes of breaking the news to her gently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a bit of searching,
I find Taiki in the
courtyard with a couple of
other students.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gulp... Okay, Fukukitaru—ready as I'll ever be! Tell me what ya see in your vision!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pri-pri, mero-mero, starry-cup... O great
Shiraoki, bestow upon me
your wisdom!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I've got it! Listen and be amazed,
Taiki!
Your lucky direction for this
month is...
east-southeast!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, yes! That's just the answer I needed, Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So Suzuka, let's have the party somewhere
to the east-south-south...
east-east? Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The east-southeast,
wasn't it? I'm not sure
what direction the

east-south-south-east-east would be...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, now—no use getting hung up on the
details!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the case, Suzuka, it's gonna be a
good time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Come to my barbecue party, and I'll feed
ya till your body's all soft
and squishy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's a kind offer, but I'm not sure I
want to be soft and squishy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I'm really happy for you,
Taiki!
Congratulations on finding
a trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Fukukitaru! Hope to see ya there
too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm wanna invite as many friends as I can.
'Cause ya know what they
say—the more
the happier!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Taiki chatting cheerfully with her
classmates, it's plain to see
that she's a
bright and friendly individual.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I just wanted to tell ya how much
I'm looking forward to our
training session
today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And, well... People tell me I can be a
smidge unfocused, but don't ya
worry! I'm
gonna give it the good ol' college try!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her boundless enthusiasm makes it all the
more difficult to turn her
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But a decision must be made...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Thanks for taking me under your
wing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, our first training session together
begins. However...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Suzuka! Howdy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Taiki—wait, stop! Please don't pounce
on me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Well, that's too bad. Hugs are a sign
of affection, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yours are a bit like being hit by a truck.
Actually, aren't you supposed
to be
training right now?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, I clean forgot!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for runnin' out on ya all of a
sudden,
Trainer! Soon as I spotted
Suzuka, my legs
just sort of went off on their own.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I know! Since you're here and all,
why don't we train together,
Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What? W-well... Would that be all right
with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though completely unplanned, having
someone with Silence Suzuka's
talent join
our session would undoubtedly prove
beneficial.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay then. I was planning to do some
distance training today, so
would you mind
if we ventured off the school grounds?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Off the grounds?! That sounds like fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No problem at all! Let's go, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Taiki. That was a question for
your trainer...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then it's off to the races! Yeehaaaaaw!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait!
S-see you in a bit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wait at the school gate for them to
return, feeling only the slightest
bit
apprehensive. Eventually, I hear the sound
of footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... We're back.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, what?! I was sure she was right
behind me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry!
She has a habit of stopping to talk
to everyone she meets, so
I meant to keep
a close eye on her...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But I have my own habit of getting tunnel
vision whenever I run... I-I'm
really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka and I search all along the running
course for Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Bang! Yes, another bullseye!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I just heard her!
I think she's over this
way!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, me next! I wanna try! Show me how
it's done!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just leave it to yours truly!
Once ya learn
my sharpshootin' skills,
you'll be just like a
hero in a Western—toy pistol or not!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Taiki! Thank goodness we
found you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it ain't Suzuka! And Trainer too!
Why're ya both so out of
breath?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, sorry! I totally forgot I was in the
middle of running!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the road ahead of us is going to
be quite the bumpy one.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well... I made some cute friends,
so... can
ya p-please forgive me this
one time?!
